description: This file defines a Dart class `ReportRepository` that provides high-level data access methods for generating financial reports based on transactions and categories stored in an SQLite database. It includes methods for calculating totals, category breakdowns, weekly trends, monthly summaries, and quick totals, all utilizing SQL queries with grouping and filtering based on date ranges.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to generate financial reports and analytics based on transaction data and categories.

methods.name: totalsInRange
methods.description: Calculates total income and expense within a specified date range using SQL joins and aggregate functions.

methods.name: categoryBreakdown
methods.description: Provides a list of category spend breakdowns within a date range, including total amount per category.

methods.name: weeklyTrend
methods.description: Generates weekly aggregated income and expense data points over a date range, with weeks starting on Monday.

methods.name: monthlySummary
methods.description: Returns monthly income and expense summaries for a given date range, bucketing data by month.

methods.name: quickTotals
methods.description: Provides quick summary of income, expense, and net totals over a date range, returning a simple map.
